mechanism_narrative: A sustained positive growth trend in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2% annualized rate compresses the risk premium and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth trend is above 2% annualized, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8.0% in a 3-month window, it signals a severe labor market contraction that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 8.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% and a rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized rate signals a 'soft landing' monetary policy that reduces equity risk premium and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.25% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3% annualized, the S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days due to elevated corporate earnings growth and reduced risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances during high real GDP growth (GDPC1 > 3% annualized), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in private sector employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% in a 3-month window signals a weakening labor market that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS decline exceeds 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 700.0 thousand units and a rise in residential sales (RSAFS) above 400000.0 million dollars signals a demand shock that compresses the equity risk premium and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 700.0 and RSAFS > 400000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized CPI growth rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
